residency_notes: SiliconFlow's public policy allows personal data to be processed by affiliates and service providers inside or outside Singapore and does not specify a customer-selected inference or storage region. Its policy does not provide a named API Zero Data Retention control for interaction data.
prompt_training_notes: SiliconFlow describes interaction data as the customer's business data and says it will only process interaction data strictly in accordance with customer instructions as a neutral technology service provider.
